requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

requires.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Academy Manufactor, or previously used to create a copy

661-1486-4231-5929--108--119.description:
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap two untapped creatures you control.
Magda triggers twice due to Leyline of Transformation, creating six Treasure tokens, six Food tokens, and six three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Sculpting Steel. If this is a clone effect, have it copy Academy Manufactor.
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap an untapped creature you control.
Magda triggers due to Leyline of Transformation, creating at least six Treasure tokens, at least three Food tokens, and at least three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for any creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
Once you have sufficient excess Treasure tokens, you may activate Magda additional times to search your library for noncreature artifacts and put them onto the battlefield.

628-5405-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Soulstinger.
When Soulstinger dies, its undying ability and second ability trigger.
Resolve the second trigger, optionally putting -1/-1 counter(s) on another creature.
Resolve the Soulstinger trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Soulstinger enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Repeat.
628-5405-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1981-2403-2415-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Moonlit Wake and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Moonlit Wake trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, surveiling 1.
Repeat.

883-1981-2415-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Ashes of the Abhorrent and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on it.
Repeat.

2034-4460-6006-6970-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

1895-2741-4399-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Pearl Medallion.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Essence Warden trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Essence Warden trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1895-2741-4399-4518.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

1409-2079-3099-6006.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1676-2438-6972.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Boss's Chauffeur.
When Boss's Chauffeur dies, its persist ability and second ability trigger.
Resolve the second trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Citizen creature tokens equal to the number of +1/+1 counters that were on Boss's Chauffeur.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Boss's Chauffeur from your graveyard to the battlefield. It'll enter with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the number of creatures you control minus 1 due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5687-6972-7379.description:
Activate Zack by paying {1} and sacrificing it.
When Zack dies, its persist ability and Skittering Precursor triggers.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Zack from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the Zack ability from step 1.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

4004-4753-7149.description:
Cast Clever Impersonator by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Clever Impersonator into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Clever Impersonator dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Wormfang Turtle, gaining its abilities.
When Clever Impersonator enters, its first ability triggers, exiling it.
When Clever Impersonator leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Clever Impersonator from exile to the battlefield. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Repeat from step 2.

465-3742-4251-5929-7175.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Oko, Lorwyn Liege // Oko, Shadowmoor Scion

1486-4644-7176.description:
Activate Oko's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, causing Tidewater Minion to gain all creature types.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting itself.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Tidewater Minion ability, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

647-1563-2557-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5315-6972-7154.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Arcbound Condor.
When Arcbound Condor dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Condor's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Condor from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

3459-5078-6723-6918.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

527-1409-4359.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {3}{G}{U}.
Activate Selvala by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Selvala enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Selvala.
Repeat.

277-681-5413-6621.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Mirrorpool can tap to produce at least {2}{C}
277-681-5413-6621.description:
Cast Splendid Reclamation by paying {3}{G}.
Holding priority, activate any number of lands you control except Mirrorpool by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}.
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing a land other than Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 3 until Mirrorpool is the only land you control.
Activate Mirrorpool's second ability by paying {2}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, copying Splendid Reclamation.
Resolve the Splendid Reclamation copy, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Repeat from step 2.

141-5231-5260.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-5231-5260.description:
Cast Entering by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Entering.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Entering, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Entering copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-5231-5260.notes: You can cast Breaking and Entering fused together to also get infinite mill and self-mill.

4083-5759-6899.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal damage to Screaming Nemesis.
Screaming Nemesis is indestructible.
4083-5759-6899.description:
Deal damage to Screaming Nemesis.
Screaming Nemesis and Repercussion trigger.
Resolve the Screaming Nemesis trigger, dealing damage to an applicable target.
Resolve the Repercussion trigger, dealing damage to Screaming Nemesis instead of you due to With Great Power....
Repeat from step 2.

276-3693-4613-6843.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Angrath's Marauders.
Activate Anti-Venom using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

141-4050-6476.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U} plus enough mana and/or cards in your graveyard to cast Afterlife from the Loam
141-4050-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Afterlife from the Loam.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Afterlife from the Loam, targeting Naru Meha and any other creature(s) as desired.
Resolve the copy of Afterlife from the Loam, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

64-372-1567.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Momentary Blink exiled by Abdel Adrian.
64-372-1567.description:
Cast Momentary Blink by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Warden of the Eye and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Warden of the Eye trigger.
Resolve the Warden of the Eye trigger, returning Momentary Blink from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Momentary Blink.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Warden of the Eye and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

575-1207-6068.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken Forest.
575-1207-6068.description:
Activate Dissection Tools' equip ability by sacrificing another nontoken Forest, which is a creature due to Ambush Commander, targeting Yedora.
When the Forest dies, Yedora triggers, returning the Forest from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Dissection Tools ability, attaching it to Yedora.
Repeat.

1369-3172-3631.notablePrerequisites:
Forests and green creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{U}.
Quicksilver Elemental does not have summoning sickness.
1369-3172-3631.description:
Cast Viridescent Wisps by paying {G}, causing Quicksliver Elemental to become green until end of turn.
Activate all Forests and green mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental by paying {U}, causing it to gain all abilities from Patron of the Orochi until end of turn.
Activate Quicksliver Elemental using Patron of the Orochi's ability by tapping it, untapping all Forests and green creatures you control.
Repeat from step 2.

811-4222-4474-5169.notablePrerequisites:
Daring Thief does not have summoning sickness.
Paradise Mantle and Freed from the Real attached to Daring Thief.
An opponent controls at least one creature.
811-4222-4474-5169.description:
Activate Daring Thief by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Daring Thief.
Daring Thief triggers, exchanging control of Khârn the Betrayer and any creature.
Khârn the Betrayer triggers, causing the player who lost control of it to draw two cards.
Repeat.

890-3338-3682-4331.notablePrerequisites: Palladium Myr does not have summoning sickness.
890-3338-3682-4331.description:
Cast Mox Amber by paying {0}.
Mirran Spy triggers, untapping Palladium Myr.
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Mox Amber from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may untap any other creature using Mirran Spy.

678-2034-4242.notablePrerequisites: You have seven or more cards in your graveyard.
678-2034-4242.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi, adding {C}{C}.
Su-Chi dies, triggering itself and Enduring Renewal.
Resolve the Su-Chi trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, causing you to return Su-Chi from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Su-Chi by paying {4}.
Repeat.

339-677-876-5256.notablePrerequisites: Lightning Greaves is attached to Jegantha.
339-677-876-5256.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Jegantha, causing target player to mill five cards.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, casting Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Jegantha.
Repeat.

876-2703-2713-4659.description:
Equip Lightning Greaves to Myr Propagator by paying {0}.
Activate Myr Propagator by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of itself.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the tapped Myr Propagator, adding {2}.
Repeat.
